momentum_note: Across utilities (Duke, NextEra), pipelines (Enbridge, TC Energy, Williams), and gas infrastructure (EQT, ONEOK, ONE Gas), the data shows accelerating revenue and capital-base growth tied explicitly to data-center power demand, regulated rate recovery, and long-duration transport contracts. Duke alone increased secured AI data-center ESAs 69% in one year with triple the pipeline. Utilities are raising capital plans ($103B at Duke) while transmission operators are sanctioning $3B-$6B+ annual capex on in-corridor expansions, LNG, and power infrastructure. The key structural pattern: hyperscalers cannot escape these companies because transmission lines and gas pipes are regulated monopolies. Nine of ten companies in this cohort reported double-digit YoY growth in the metrics tied to this theme (EBITDA, earnings, rate base, throughput, backlog).
